title: Integer multiplicity limits of the deformation series: T − Q = ∂R₁ + S₁ with mass bounds and vanishing sets
statement: Assume (IMS) (the exact frozen statement of dor_lmb_fc_im_series, as an antecedent): for all P, m, open U ⊆ ℝ^P and IM X_r ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) (r ∈ ℕ) with Σ_r M(X_r) ≠ ∞ there is an IM Y ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) with HasSum (X_r(ω))_r (Y(ω)) for every ω and M(Y) ≤ Σ_r M(X_r). Let P, m ∈ ℕ, c ∈ ℝ, T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) (domain univ) with M(T) ≠ ∞ and M(∂T) ≠ ∞, V_j, E'_j, A_j, K_j ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P), H_j ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P), Y_j, L_j ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) (j ∈ ℕ) and F₁, F₂ ⊆ ℝ^P. Assume: V_j, H_j, E'_j are IM; (h1) Σ_{j≤N} V_j(ω) − T(ω) + A_N(ω) − Σ_{j≤N} ∂H_j(ω) = Σ_{j≤N} E'_j(ω) − K_N(ω) for all N and ω ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}; (h2) Σ_{j≤N} ∂V_j(ω) = Σ_{j≤N} Y_j(ω) − L_N(ω) for all N and ω ∈ 𝒟^m; M(A_N) → 0, M(K_N) → 0, M(L_N) → 0; Σ_j M(V_j) ≤ c·M(T), Σ_j M(H_j) ≤ c·M(T), Σ_j M(E'_j) ≤ c·M(∂T), Σ_j M(Y_j) ≤ c·M(∂T) (c via ENNReal.ofReal); every V_j vanishes off F₁ and every H_j and E'_j vanishes off F₂. Then there are IM Q ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P), R₁ ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P), S₁ ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with T(ω) − Q(ω) = ∂R₁(ω) + S₁(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}, M(Q) ≤ c·M(T), M(∂Q) ≤ c·M(∂T), M(R₁) ≤ c·M(T), M(S₁) ≤ c·M(∂T), Q vanishing off F₁, and R₁, S₁ vanishing off F₂.
